assumptions: Anchor is 'center' because top-down boxes use centre as metric position; bottom_center is only the downstream AABB edge, not ground contact.
Stop is interpreted as DWELL in stop_zone with max_speed 0.05; statute gives no stop duration so 500 ms is assumed as minimum detectable stopped dwell.
stop_zone represents 'near side' and 'clearly marked stop line' as the last 10 metres before the stop line.
Inbound approach direction is encoded as CROSSES to_right per line definition (+y = to_right); vehicles that never cross inbound pass vacuously.
No time limit between stop and crossing is enforced; within_ms is null.
'Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal' cannot be seen by the camera and is excluded from the check.
raw_output.normalized_explanation: Any vehicle that crosses the stop line inbound must have first remained stopped in the approach waiting zone for at least 500 ms.

provenance.quote: driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection

provenance.reason: Top-down view: centre is metric position; bottom_center is downstream AABB edge, not ground contact, per line description.

provenance.quote: stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute states 'shall stop' with no duration; 500 ms chosen as minimum reliably detectable stopped dwell.

provenance.quote: at a clearly marked stop line

provenance.reason: Statute says 'approaching'; line definition maps inbound +y movement to to_right, so to_right encodes approaching direction.

text: Unless otherwise directed by a police officer or traffic control signal, the driver of a vehicle approaching a stop sign at an intersection shall stop at the near side of the intersection at a clearly marked stop line.
